@echo off
echo Restoring Windows Snipping Tool (Screen Sketch)...
PowerShell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers *ScreenSketch* | Foreach {Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register '$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml'}" >nul 2>&1
echo Snipping Tool restored.
pause
